- scrapebee_get_body: This endpoint of scrapebee get body from URL of site to scrape
- text_to_image_ai: The "AI to create any text into image" API allows developers to convert text into an image using artificial intelligence. The API takes in a text input and generates an image output. The API can be in
- send_email: Its simple as that just send message and a delivery email and thats all. It needs two parameters a  Mensjae variable that is text, this is the message on the email that you will send
Could you grab the content from https://www.nexusblog.io/updates/q3-product-launch to create a promotional image and then email the link to marketing-dist@nexuscorp.com?
